title: Multi-Gas Environmental Monitor Using Metal Oxide Nanowire Array
abstract: An environmental monitor with metal oxide nanowire array (SnO2, ZnO, WO3, In2O3) at different temperatures with ML pattern recognition detecting gases at ppb levels.
claims: Four nanowire elements at independently controlled 150-400C.
Random forest (500 trees) achieving >95% gas identification.
Micro-hotplate <50mW per element, thermal isolation >50 K/mW.
problem_statement: Individual gas sensors lack selectivity. E-nose arrays with ML can discriminate complex mixtures.
